title: The Art Exhibition and the Pregnancy

scenes.title: Max's Return
scenes.summary: Max returns to the hotel after hearing from Filipp that Vika is pregnant, only for Vika to claim the baby is not his.

scenes.title: Friends in Misfortune
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov is horrified to find Elena and his ex-wife Eleonora bonding over their failed first marriages without Elena knowing the truth.

scenes.title: Eleonora's Game and Kostya's Advice
scenes.summary: Barinov accuses Eleonora of trying to ruin his relationship with Elena, while Kostya comforts Max and tells him to get some sleep.

scenes.title: Denis's Invented Secret
scenes.summary: Denis tells Kostya that he and Katya broke up, and Kostya invents a story for Nastya about Denis having an ex-wife and daughter in Voronezh.

scenes.title: The Finnish Ambassador and the Exhibition
scenes.summary: Elena convinces Barinov to attend a modern art exhibition tomorrow, and Mikhail warns him that the Finnish ambassador is dining at the restaurant.

scenes.title: Counting the Weeks
scenes.summary: At Kostya and Nastya's apartment, Nastya helps Max calculate that Vika should be twenty weeks pregnant if the baby is his.

scenes.title: Visit to Vika's Doctor
scenes.summary: Max visits Vika's obstetrician pretending to pick up her test results, but the doctor reveals that Vika warned her about him.

scenes.title: Black and White at the Exhibition
scenes.summary: At the modern art exhibition, Barinov mocks the paintings until Eleonora steps out and reveals that she is the artist.

scenes.title: The Painting 'Ex-Husband'
scenes.summary: While Barinov steps away for champagne, Eleonora reveals to Elena that Victor Petrovich is her cowardly first husband.

scenes.title: Nastya Spills the Secret to Katya
scenes.summary: Unable to hold back any longer, Nastya tells Katya the made-up story that Denis broke up with her because he needs a mother for his daughter.

scenes.title: Prenatal Classes for Expectant Parents
scenes.summary: Nastya confesses to Kostya that she told Katya, while Max sneaks into Elena Vladimirovna's childbirth class with a fake pregnant belly.

scenes.title: Katya Forgives Denis
scenes.summary: Katya tells a bewildered Denis that Kostya told her everything and promises that the three of them will rent an apartment together.

scenes.title: Two Ex-Wives at the Restaurant
scenes.summary: Barinov bursts into Eleonora's office, and when Elena arrives to confront him, he panics and claims his second ex-wife Tatyana is in the dining room.

scenes.title: The Suspicious Woman in the Dining Room
scenes.summary: Barinov approaches a female guest in the dining room and tells her that Elena is a suspected swindler so the two women will not speak.

scenes.title: Victor's Confession
scenes.summary: Barinov catches up with Elena in the lobby and confesses that Eleonora is his ex-wife, only to learn that Elena already knew from the exhibition.

scenes.title: The Vigilant Guest and Elena's Bag
scenes.summary: When Elena returns for her forgotten handbag, the guest Barinov warned tackles her and calls security, thinking Elena is a thief.

scenes.title: Sixteen Weeks
scenes.summary: Max begs Vika's doctor for the truth, and she tells him that Vika is sixteen weeks pregnant—less than four months along.

scenes.title: Gratitude for the Gossip
scenes.summary: Denis thanks Kostya for being a blabbermouth because Katya forgave him, until Kostya tries to warn him about the daughter lie.

scenes.title: Denis's Bitter Truth
scenes.summary: When Eleonora brings up Denis's supposed daughter, Denis takes Katya aside and confesses the real truth: he got drunk and cheated on her.

scenes.title: The Doctor's Call and Denis's Departure
scenes.summary: Max confronts Vika about the doctor's sixteen-week answer, Denis packs his bags and leaves the hotel, and Vika's doctor calls to confirm she lied to Max as Vika asked.
